how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:priest-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:5658:details:0: You be far from home, ⟦1⟧. You be needed there, back in your city under the ground. Your mistress, the one you be callin' Aelthalyste be needin' you back there. Like my tribe, there things you must learn only from her. Don't be stayin' here too long. You should be headin' to the War Quarter as fast as a zeppelin can carry you.
rows.quest:5658:completion:0: Ah, young ⟦2⟧, I am glad you have returned here. I would teach you a lesson you would do well to not forget. Are you prepared?
rows.quest:5660:details:0: You be far from home, ⟦3⟧. You be needed there, back in your city under the ground. Your mistress, the one you be callin' Aelthalyste be needin' you back there. Like my tribe, there things you must learn only from her. Don't be stayin' here too long. You should be headin' to the War Quarter as fast as a zeppelin can carry you.
rows.quest:5660:completion:0: Ah, good, another has arrived. Time may not matter to me, but to you it is of the essence. There is much for you to learn and there is much I wish to teach you. You simply must prove your worth. Do that, and you shall be greatly rewarded.
rows.quest:5661:details:0: You be far from home out here in the Bloodhoof Village, ⟦4⟧. I be sent here to find priests of my own tribe to send back to speak to our leaders, but that not mean I cannot help you too.
rows.quest:5661:details:1: BI hear word that your head priestess spirit want all ⟦E2⟧ to come to her--there are things you must learn.
rows.quest:5661:details:2: BGo to meet Aelthalyste in the War Quarter in that city of yours.
rows.quest:5661:completion:0: Ah, good, another has arrived. Time may not matter to me, but to you it is of the essence. There is much for you to learn and there is much I wish to teach you. You simply must prove your worth. Do that, and you shall be greatly rewarded.
rows.quest:5662:details:0: My respect to you and your kind, ⟦5⟧. I normally teach only those of my own tribe. Your lessons come from Aelthalyste in the city once called Lordaeron.
rows.quest:5662:details:1: BYou should return to her if you're to learn those abilities that set you apart from other faiths.
rows.quest:5662:details:2: BGo to the War Quarter in the ⟦E1⟧ and find your mistress there.
rows.quest:5662:completion:0: Ah, good, another has arrived. Time may not matter to me, but to you it is of the essence. There is much for you to learn and there is much I wish to teach you. You simply must prove your worth. Do that, and you shall be greatly rewarded.
rows.quest:5663:details:0: Aelthalyste sent word out to all her priests. We're to direct the younger of our order to the ⟦E1⟧ for more training. If you truly count yourself among our faithful, then you should return there also.
rows.quest:5663:details:1: BYou can find Aelthalyste in the War Quarter deep in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5663:completion:0: Ah, good, another has arrived. Time may not matter to me, but to you it is of the essence. There is much for you to learn and there is much I wish to teach you. You simply must prove your worth. Do that, and you shall be greatly rewarded.
rows.quest:5672:details:0: A wonderful day has come, ⟦6⟧. You've reached the age in which our ⟦7⟧ are trained in abilities only Night elves know. But it is not for me to train you. You must return to the Temple of the Moon and speak to Priestess Alathea as soon as your business here is concluded. She will test you to ensure you're prepared, and only then will she teach you ⟦E4⟧'s Grace.
rows.quest:5672:completion:0: By devoting yourself to ⟦E4⟧ and our people, you have attained a state that not all of us can achieve. It is tradition that you then be taught even greater abilities for your devotion. Do you accept?
rows.quest:5673:details:0: You know you have access to any of our trainers at any time, ⟦8⟧, but there are some things that we cannot pass on to you. One of those things are the teachings of your goddess ⟦E4⟧. She gives special abilities to her faithful, and if I'm not mistaken, it is time for you to return home to your Temple of the Moon to be tested.
rows.quest:5673:details:1: BReturn there when you can and speak to Priestess Alathea.
rows.quest:5673:completion:0: ⟦E4⟧ bless you for returning so quickly to us. This is an important time in your training, and a time that all of our order take very seriously. When you've rested from your journey here, please, let me know. We can then discuss the continuation of your training and where your path will lead you next.
rows.quest:5674:details:0: A wonderful day has come, ⟦9⟧. You've reached the age in which our ⟦10⟧ are trained in abilities only Night elves know. But it is not for me to train you. You must return to the Temple of the Moon and speak to Priestess Alathea as soon as your business here is concluded. She will test you to ensure you're prepared, and only then will she teach you ⟦E4⟧'s Grace.
rows.quest:5674:completion:0: By devoting yourself to ⟦E4⟧ and our people, you have attained a state that not all of us can achieve. It is tradition that you then be taught even greater abilities for your devotion. Do you accept?
rows.quest:5675:details:0: Time's a wastin', ⟦11⟧. It's time for you to return home to ⟦E3⟧. Priestess Alathea's sent word here that you're to return there for training. Seems they feel you're ready to be tested much like those who serve the Light. You should head out whenever you can. Alathea's message said that she'd be waitin' for you in the Temple of the Moon. Good luck.
rows.quest:5675:completion:0: ⟦E4⟧ bless you for returning so quickly to us. This is an important time in your training, and a time that all of our order take very seriously. When you've rested from your journey here, please, let me know. We can then discuss the continuation of your training and where your path will lead you next.
rows.quest:5676:obj:0: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:5676:details:0: It is time for you to return to ⟦E5⟧, young one. Your superiors there have called you back for more training. And although it disturbs me some, your race and mine are allies and I would not betray that.
rows.quest:5676:details:1: B I do not mean to be so coy with you--my distrust of arcane magics, be they divine inspired or not, is still strong within me.
rows.quest:5676:details:2: B You will know of what I speak after you return to your Cathedral of Light. Speak to High Priestess Laurena when you arrive.
rows.quest:5676:completion:0: We were forced to learn some magics to protect us from what is commonly called our greatest enemy: the arcane.
rows.quest:5676:completion:1: BI would teach you a spell to help you defend yourself and your companions from those who would wield such power.
rows.quest:5677:obj:0: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:5677:details:0: As much as I'd like to show you our own special teachings of the Light, it is not our place. Your place is back in ⟦E5⟧ with your own kind, ⟦12⟧... for now. Believe me, I mean no offense. When you return to High Priestess Laurena in the Cathedral of Light you'll understand what I'm talking about--the time has come for your race to prepare you for the future; to separate yourself from others that follow a similar path.
rows.quest:5677:completion:0: We were forced to learn some magics to protect us from what is commonly called our greatest enemy: the arcane.
rows.quest:5677:completion:1: BI would teach you a spell to help you defend yourself and your companions from those who would wield such power.
rows.quest:5679:details:0: Aelthalyste show our people great respect by sending them back to me for more training, and now I do the same for her tribe.
rows.quest:5679:details:1: BYou return to the ⟦E1⟧, ⟦13⟧. There, in the War Quarter, she be ready to teach you more 'bout your people and their ways. Go there, and do not wait long.
rows.quest:5679:completion:0: I would teach you ⟦E6⟧ if you feel you are prepared, ⟦14⟧. A spell of no small power, it will aid you in your coming battles. Practice with it--there will be tests later.
rows.quest:5680:details:0: Like many of our own priests, your own tribe puts you through rites of passage. These rites often teach priests special abilities that are vital to their survival. I sense that time is upon you even as we speak. You must return to the Valley of Spirits in ⟦E7⟧ and speak to Ur'kyo. What he teaches you might be very important for the future.
rows.quest:5680:completion:0: Your rites will come soon enough. For now, I teach you a spell that will be of great use to you when you do battle with your enemies.
rows.quest:7621:completion:0: ⟦15⟧, you are about to undergo a rigorous series of events which shall test all of your abilities.
rows.quest:7621:completion:1: BI suggest that you listen to the story that I have to tell.
rows.quest:7621:completion:2: BBe warned, you must complete this task alone. It is recommended that your allies remain at a distance. Interference by outside agents will result in a most severe punishment.
rows.quest:7621:completion:3: BDestiny has led you and you alone here. Battle with honor. Harness the Light.
rows.quest:7622:obj:0: Save 50 Peasants before 15 are slain. Speak with Eris Havenfire should you accomplish this task.
rows.quest:7622:obj:1: BYou may view the Death Post to view how many Peasants have been slain.
rows.quest:7622:details:0: You must do what I could not: Save the peasants that were cut down while fleeing from ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:7622:details:1: BThey will walk towards the light, you must ensure their survival. Should too many fall, our cursed existence shall continue - you will have failed.
rows.quest:7622:details:2: BEvery ability, prayer, and spell that you have learned will be tested. May the Light protect you, ⟦16⟧.
rows.quest:7622:completion:0: Your tenacity and courage are astounding, ⟦17⟧. You have earned the right to hold the Splinter of Nordrassil. Only one task remains: The Eye of Shadow must be recovered. Scour the world.
rows.quest:8254:details:0: It is the way of the divine to help those in need. The how is insignificant -- only the why matters.
rows.quest:8254:details:1: BThe Cenarion Circle has such a need. Speak with Ogtinc to lend aid to their plight. He resides atop the cliffs to the northeast of the Ruins of Eldarath in ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:8254:completion:0: Your arrival has lifted a weight from my shoulders. We have much to do.
rows.quest:8255:obj:0: Acquire 4 Healthy Courser Glands and bring them to Ogtinc in ⟦E9⟧. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
rows.quest:8255:details:0: The mosshoof coursers of ⟦E9⟧ are magnificent animals who once lived in ⟦E10⟧. They naturally resist disease and poison, and were unaffected by the corruption there. In their ancestral wisdom, they simply chose to leave that sickened place.
rows.quest:8255:details:1: BIt saddens my heart, but I must ask you to hunt these mighty beasts for me. Gather four courser glands as the first ingredient for a restorative salve -- a salve we will use to heal ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:8255:completion:0: It is good the divine path has led you to us, ⟦18⟧. Your beliefs do not interfere with the tasks involved in creating this salve.
rows.quest:8255:completion:1: BYou see, the courser is sacred to the Cenarion Circle, and killing them for any reason, no matter how necessary, weakens their spirit.
rows.quest:8256:obj:0: Acquire an Ichor of Undeath for Ogtinc in ⟦E9⟧. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
rows.quest:8256:details:0: For this restorative salve, you must use a simple formula: one part poison, two parts cure. You have acquired one cure, now you must gather the poison.
rows.quest:8256:details:1: BPowerful undead, such as the lingering highborne who wander the Ruins of Eldarath, are sometimes so infused with evil that it coalesces into a sickly greenish goo. To the living, this substance is known as ichor of undeath.
rows.quest:8256:details:2: BDue to the potency of this vile element, I require only a single ichor.
rows.quest:8256:completion:0: I cannot say I'm pleased to receive such a wretched substance, but it is a necessary evil. Thank you, ⟦19⟧.
rows.quest:8257:obj:0: Kill Morphaz in the sunken temple of Atal'Hakkar, and return his blood to Greta Mosshoof in ⟦E10⟧. The entrance to the sunken temple can be found in the ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:8257:details:0: Now the last part, the second cure.
rows.quest:8257:details:1: BThe green drake Morphaz is known to be immune to all forms of poison and disease -- many druids died to bring us this information. There is no doubt his blood is potent for our needs.
rows.quest:8257:details:2: BA courier from the Cenarion Circle will take the parts you have already collected while you gather the last. Summon your allies and seek out the drake's lair in the sunken temple of Atal'Hakkar. Bring his blood to Greta Mosshoof in ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:8257:completion:0: You have slain Morphaz and carried his blood to us... I can hardly believe this good news!
rows.quest:8257:completion:1: BWe will combine the ingredients at once and begin healing the trees and creatures of ⟦E10⟧. It will take a lifetime to undo what has happened here, but you have given us the means to do it.
